Namo Narayana Ghee Review: Price, Quality, Founder & Value Analysis

Quick Summary / Key Takeaways

  • Milk Source: 100% indigenous Gir cows (Bos indicus) from Gujarat and Haryana gaushalas with free-grazing and Ahimsa ethical milking practices.
  • Method: Vedic Bilona method (boiled whole milk → curd cultured → bi-directional wooden churning → cultured makkhan slow-simmered → golden danedar ghee).
  • Official Store Price: 500ml at ₹599, 1 Litre flagship pack at ₹949 (Best Seller), 2.5 Litres at ₹2,099 (Best Family Value), and 5 Litres at ₹3,499. Free pan-India delivery with zero hidden charges.

  • Purity & Quality: FSSAI certified, zero preservatives, zero added colours, no palm oil or vanaspati, >99.5% pure milk fat, and <0.5% moisture with batch lab test reports.
  • Customer Verdict: 4.9/5 stars across 1,688+ verified buyer reviews with high praise for authentic grainy (danedar) texture and nutty makkhan aroma.
